# Scratch-only native diagnostic. Never load this in a price worker.
require "fiddle"
require File.expand_path("config/boot", Dir.pwd)
require "json"
require "digest"
root = ENV.fetch("DIAG_ROOT")
require File.join(root, "bench/experiments/yjit_entry_reader")
require File.expand_path("config/environment", Dir.pwd)
require "rack/mock"
raise "native YJIT required" unless RubyVM::YJIT.enabled?
Rails.application.eager_load!
Rails.logger.level = :warn
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = nil
method = ActiveRecord::ConnectionAdapters::ConnectionPool.instance_method(:discarded?)
iseq = RubyVM::InstructionSequence.of(method)
pointer = YjitEntryReader::UNWRAP.call(Fiddle.dlwrap(iseq))
body = Fiddle::Pointer.new(pointer)[16, 8].unpack1("Q")
progress = Fiddle::Pointer.malloc(16)
progress[0, 16] = [0, 0].pack("Q2")
frequencies = ActiveRecord::Base.connection_handler.connection_pool_list(:all).map do |pool|
  {db: pool.db_config.name, reaper_frequency: pool.reaper.frequency}
end
metadata = {pid: Process.pid, ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION, mode: ENV.fetch("LOWRAIL"),
  source: method.source_location, source_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(method.source_location.first).hexdigest,
  body: body, progress: progress.to_i, initial: YjitEntryReader.state(iseq), pools: frequencies,
  manifest_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(Dir.pwd, ".lowrail/manifest.json")).hexdigest,
  root: root, root_sha: IO.popen(["/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], &:read).strip}
File.write(ENV.fetch("DIAG_META"), JSON.pretty_generate(metadata))
raise "entry installed before recorder; do not manufacture another threshold" if metadata[:initial][:entry]
Process.kill("STOP", Process.pid)
start = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
session = Rack::MockRequest.new(Rails.application)
index = 0
[[1, 1, 50], [2, 200, 50], [3, 10, 200]].each do |phase, batches, count|
  batches.times do
    count.times do
      index += 1
      progress[0, 16] = [index, phase].pack("Q2")
      response = session.get("/articles/1", "HTTP_HOST" => "localhost", "HTTPS" => "on")
      raise "unexpected response" unless response.status == 200
    end
    GC.start
    raise "diagnostic hard cap" if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - start > 180
  end
end
progress[0, 16] = [index, 4].pack("Q2")
remaining = 90 - (Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - start)
sleep remaining if remaining.positive?
metadata.merge!(requests: index, final: YjitEntryReader.state(iseq),
  admissions: %w[FormScaffold TokenTag CollectionRender].to_h { |name| [name, Lowrail.const_get(name).admission] })
File.write(ENV.fetch("DIAG_FINAL"), JSON.pretty_generate(metadata))
puts "DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY requests=#{index} entry=#{metadata[:final][:entry]} calls=#{metadata[:final][:calls]}"
